name: Caterpillar - York PA Distribution Center
type: Parts distribution center (~1.1M sq ft, opened 1953)

fieldNotes.site: Confirmed as the Caterpillar York Distribution Center, 600 Memory Lane, Springettsbury Township - a ~1.1M sq ft parts depot opened 1953. Roster geocode (39.981109, -76.686396, ROOFTOP, moved 808m) landed on the building. Identified by the green-and-white industrial building visible in Street View along Memory Lane, the depot layout, and adjacency to US-30.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck/dock yards are enclosed by chain-link perimeter fencing (confirmed at the SW building face in Street View). Truck operations on the NE and SW are access-controlled behind the fence. A small white structure near the SE truck yard may be a booth. No barrier arm cleanly imaged. truckGate set true; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth positively confirmed; a small structure near the SE truck yard is ambiguous. remoteGs set true assuming kiosk/badge check-in. Both flagged.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock-door banks confirmed on the NE face (rows of trailers backed in) and the SW face. 50+ band; exact count low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop yards on the NE and SE with parked trailers; 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on the NE face and the SW face are on physically separate building faces.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal truck routes around the large building give ample queueing room.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Springettsbury Township is part of the York PA metro / suburban fabric, bordered by US-30 with dense commercial and residential development - classed Urban per rubric.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the south edge of the property with apparent spur access; railServed set true.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified; left false.
fieldNotes.metrics: Counts are honest estimates from overhead imagery of an older 1.1M sq ft DC; flagged.
